contamination_barrier: Read only snapshot schema and pre-existing aggregate contracts; no population rows, truth rows, candidate availability, or outcomes queried.
minimum_selection_design_amendment_requi: Explicitly restrict S2B selection inputs to fields carried by a newly frozen evidence snapshot, or create and bind a separate immutable evidence snapshot containing exact migrations, funding edges, population-wide topology/behaviour/migration-actor sources, and truth tables.
Specify contrast predicates and precedence over that bound schema; do not use external mutable corpora without provenance/high-water/digest bindings.
If unavailable dimensions are allowed as false/-1, amend the control/contrast design explicitly to state which required classes remain selectable and how truth joins are sourced.
next_authorization: human approval for a selection-design amendment that either freezes a complete evidence snapshot or narrows/removes requirements unsupported by population-wide bound evidence.
snapshot_schema_tables: CREATE TABLE pumpfun_migration_verification (mint TEXT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE token_analysis (mint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pf_ws_creator TEXT)

source_definition.behaviour: P3 census records no population-wide behaviour adapter.
source_definition.contrast_predicates: No bound source can define shared-funding or CEX ancestry; ordinary class and overlap precedence would therefore be discretionary.
source_definition.direct_funding: No direct_funding_edges relation is present in the frozen source boundary; an external local corpus is not frozen/bound for S2B selection.
source_definition.ep3_topology: P2 census explicitly records population-wide EP3 topology unavailable; retained EP3 corpora are control-cohort bounded.
source_definition.fanout_band: No bound population-wide funding/topology grouping relation is present.
source_definition.migration_actor: P3 census records no population-wide migration-signer adapter.
source_definition.migration_week: No migrated_at column exists in the frozen snapshot schema; no bound migration timestamp relation is present.
source_definition.three_sw2_truth: Pre-existing artifact names an evidence DB but no machine-executable table/key/version mapping is frozen.
source_definition.upstream_funding: No upstream_edges relation is present in the frozen source boundary; same unbound external-corpus issue.
source_definition.watchtower_truth: Pre-existing artifact names a truth table but no bound cross-database natural-key specification/version is frozen.
